method: GitHub API age/stars/forks check (created 2026-07-22, 535 stars, 54 forks); read the repo's open issues; pulled the FontCrafter HN thread (482 points, 157 comments) via the Algolia API for first-hand comments; web search on the Chinese glyph-count barrier.
gap: It only works where the alphabet is small. Non-Latin users hit a wall immediately, and for Chinese the standard character set is 6,763 glyphs — writing them out by hand is why consumer handwriting fonts basically do not exist there.

zh.pain: 想把还在世的长辈的笔迹印在明年春联上的人——手写几千个字，写到一半放弃了。
zh.kill: 字库公司早就在卖手写风格的中文字体，管线现成；少样本补字要做到能看是真的技术风险，一笔生成得别扭，母语读者一眼就出戏。
zh.move: 打的是补字这道坎，不是字体导出：手写 300 字、补出常用 1000 字，交付的不是字体文件而是一件情绪成品——一副用奶奶笔迹排好的春联，或一封家书。冷启动（中文）：小红书、B 站「手写字体制作」教程下的评论区，那里全是写到一半放弃的人；再加知乎「如何制作一款自己的中文字体」回答区的追问。冷启动（英文）：r/fonts 与 r/typography 搜 handwriting font。
zh.hook: 一个奶奶还在世、想把奶奶的字留在明年春联上的人。他为了做字体开始一个个抄字，抄到 6763 个里的前几百个就放弃了。
zh.does: 在纸上写 300 个字，拍照传进去。它用这只手生成常用的 1000 字，然后给你一件做完的东西——一副春联，或者一套家书，用奶奶的字排好、可以直接打印。不是字体文件，是成品。
zh.counter: 字库公司早就在卖手写风格中文字体，管线也在他们手里。少样本字形合成要做到可用质量是真实的研究风险，而一笔写错，在母语读者眼里是明显到难堪的错——这个领域对「大体上对」零容忍。上游仓库自己的 issue 已经暴露了浅水区：乌克兰语用户拿到的是英文字表，而且不支持连笔，可大多数人就是连着写的。
zh.differentiator: 打字形缺口，不打字体导出。这个方向上出货的人都在出 .ttf；真正让人掏钱的是一件印出来的、带着一个已故或年迈的人手迹的东西，而这个没人在卖。冷启动（中）：小红书与 B站「手写字体制作」教程下的评论区，那里挤满了抄到一半放弃的人；加知乎「如何制作一款自己的中文字体」下的追问。冷启动（英）：r/fonts、r/typography 搜 handwriting font，以及 FontCrafter 那条 482 分 HN 帖里要连笔的评论者。
zh.consumer_angle: 拿走的人是一个想留住家里老人字迹的普通人。他拿走的是一副用奶奶的字写的春联，不是一个字体文件。

pain: Anyone with a living grandparent whose handwriting they want on next year's spring couplets, who gave up halfway through writing out thousands of characters by hand.
kill: Type foundries already sell handwriting-style Chinese fonts and have the pipeline; few-shot glyph synthesis at usable quality is a real research risk, and a bad generated stroke reads as obviously wrong to a native reader.
move: Attack the glyph gap, not the font export: write 300 characters, generate the common 1,000, and ship one emotionally finished artefact (a spring couplet or a family letter set in grandma's hand) rather than a font file. Cold start (Chinese): the comment sections under 手写字体制作 tutorials on Xiaohongshu and Bilibili, which are full of people who gave up halfway, plus the follow-up questions under the Zhihu answer 如何制作一款自己的中文字体. Cold start (English): r/fonts and r/typography, search 'handwriting font'.
hook: Someone whose grandmother is still alive and whose handwriting they want on next year's spring couplets. They started copying out characters by hand for a font, and quit somewhere in the first few hundred of 6,763.
does: Write 300 characters on paper and photograph the sheets. It generates the common 1,000 in that hand and returns one finished thing — a pair of spring couplets, or a set of family letters, set in grandma's writing and ready to print. Not a font file. An artefact.
counter: Type foundries already sell handwriting-style Chinese fonts and own the pipeline. Few-shot glyph synthesis at usable quality is a live research risk, and one bad stroke reads as obviously, embarrassingly wrong to a native reader — this is a domain with no tolerance for 'mostly right'. The upstream repo's own issues show the shallow end of the problem: it silently produced the English table for a Ukrainian user, and does not do cursive, which is how most people actually write.
differentiator: Attack the glyph gap, not the font export. Everyone shipping in this space ships a .ttf; the emotional purchase is a printed object with a dead or ageing person's hand on it, and nobody sells that. Cold start (Chinese): the comment sections under 手写字体制作 tutorials on 小红书 and B站, which are full of people who gave up halfway, plus the follow-up questions under 知乎「如何制作一款自己的中文字体」. Cold start (English): r/fonts and r/typography on 'handwriting font', and the FontCrafter HN thread (482 points) commenters who asked for cursive.
consumer_angle: 拿走的人是一个想留住家里老人字迹的普通人。他拿走的是一副用奶奶的字写的春联、一套家书——今晚就能打印出来贴上。不是一个字体文件，不是一份工程产物。
